requirements.description: The user prefers a property in energy class C or better, so the energy class must be C, B, or any A class (A1-A4). The area, capacity, Turin location, and public transport requirements are not energy-related and are not extracted.
User wants the building located near public transport. Threshold set at the 75th percentile of the mobility distribution (70.93, rounded to 71).

The project is a university student residence, so proximity to universities and schools is clearly necessary. Threshold set at the 75th percentile of the education distribution (75.14, rounded to 75).

The user requires at least 850 sqm of gross floor area. The 60-person capacity is not converted into an area filter because no verified gross-property-area threshold from the RegulatoryAgent is available. Energy class and public transport proximity are not reference columns and are excluded. Turin is a geographic criterion handled by the Location Agent.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Uffici e assimilabili' AND surface_area >= 850 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND mobility >= 71 AND education >= 75 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters the ESTATES table to office-type properties (property_type 'Uffici e assimilabili') with surface_area of at least 850 sqm, energy_class A1–A4, B or C, mobility score >= 71 and education score >= 75, within 3.0 km of the given coordinates (45.0677551, 7.6824892). Results are ordered by haversine distance from that point, nearest first. The 60-person capacity is not an extracted requirement, so it is not filtered.
